<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AssertNoExtraKeys, NavigationMenuProps } from "@/lib/utils";
import { cn, navigationMenuVariants } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import NavigationMenuViewport from "./navigation-menu-viewport.vue";

type Props = NavigationMenuProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] };
type _NavigationMenuPropsGuard = AssertNoExtraKeys<
  Props,
  NavigationMenuProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }
>;

const props = defineProps<Props>();
</script>

<template>
  <nav
    data-slot="navigation-menu"
    :class="
      cn(navigationMenuVariants(), props.class)
    "
  >
    <slot />
    <NavigationMenuViewport />
  </nav>
</template>

<view class="navigation-menu {{extClass}}">
  <view
    wx:for="{{items}}"
    wx:key="value"
    class="navigation-menu-item {{item.value === value ? 'is-active' : ''}} {{item.disabled ? 'is-disabled' : ''}}"
    data-value="{{item.value}}"
    bindtap="onSelect"

    <text>{{item.label}}</text>
  </view>
